info.name: CDR API
info.description:
## Introduction
The Consumer Data Right (CDR) APIs allow Registered Financially Responsible Market Participants (FRMPs) to service API requests for AEMO data from Accredited Data Recipients.

header.description: Specifies the encoding support for the response.
(Required) The participant ID who the request is from.
(Required) Version of the API supported by AEMO. E.g 1
Minimum version of the API supported by AEMO that can be accepted.  E.g. 1

(Required) The x-fapi-interaction-id is supplied for end to end tracing. If the ADR has not populated this on their API call to the retailer, the retailer must generate a unique value to pass through to AEMO.
(Required) Arrangement ID for the consent that the request is being made under to be used for tracing and audit purposes. AEMO will not validate the consent associated with the arrangement.

Page size. Default is 25 (standard pagination). Maximum page size of 1000 results.
For Internal AEMO pagination purpose
Oldest date data is to be returned for. Should be no earlier than current date minus 24 months. If not provided, current date minus 24 months is assumed.

Interval read values,FULL or 30MIN.Default value is NONE if no value provided.
